Sling

A modern and reactive backpack UI for Roblox.

![GitHub Workflow Status](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/encodedlux/sling/CI.yml?style=for-the-badge&branch=main&logo=github) [![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/encodedlux/sling?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/encodedlux/sling/releases/latest) [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-online-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=gitbook)](https://encodedlux.github.io/sling/) [![Sling Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Try_in_roblox-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=roblox)](https://www.roblox.com/games/128963890251413) [![GitHub License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/encodedlux/sling?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE)
## About Sling is a modern and reactive backpack UI designed for Roblox experiences. It replaces the default backpack system, giving you complete freedom to customize the interface however you want, dynamically categorize inventory items, and use or create custom themes.
--- ## Features * [**Custom Categorization** 🎒](https://encodedlux.github.io/sling/tut/crash-course/3-category) - Group your inventory items into tab categories (e.g., Weapons, Potions, Resources) using simple, custom declarative predicate functions. * [**Custom Themes** 🎨](https://encodedlux.github.io/sling/tut/crash-course/4-themes) - Customize theme properties, switch between predefined themes (default and light), or define your own. * [**Subscribe to Events** 🔔](https://encodedlux.github.io/sling/tut/crash-course/5-events) - Track when the player interacts with their backpack, equips items, or when items are added/removed. * [**Manage Hotbar** 🔢](https://encodedlux.github.io/sling/tut/crash-course/6-hotbar) - Track when the user rearranges items and programmatically set which items should be placed in the hotbar. --- ## Installation ### Github Releases 1. Download the `sling.rbxm` model file from the [Github Releases](https://github.com/encodedlux/sling/releases/latest). 2. Open Roblox Studio and create a new place or open an existing place. 3. In the Explorer window, insert **Sling** into **ReplicatedStorage**. 4. local function wasAlreadyCreated(category: string)
	local state = states.categories()
	for _, v in state do
		if v.category == category then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--[=[
	Creates a new category for the inventory.
	
	```luau
	sling.createCategory("Weapons", function(item)
		return item:HasTag("Weapon")
	end)
    ```
]=]
local function createCategory(category: string, predicate: types.CategoryPredicate)
	assert(not wasAlreadyCreated(category), `Category {category} already exists`)
	local newCategory = { category = category, predicate = predicate }
	local state = states.categories()
	table.insert(state, newCategory)
	states.categories(state)
end

return createCategory

	sling.onSlotRender(function(context)

type Listener<Args... = ...any> = (Args...) -> ()
type Event<Args... = ...any> = {
	on: (listener: Listener<Args...>) -> () -> (),
	fire: (Args...) -> (),
}

local freeThreads: { thread } = {}

local function run<T...>(f: (T...) -> (), thread: thread, ...)
	f(...)
	table.insert(freeThreads, thread)
end

local function yielder()
	while true do
		run(coroutine.yield())
	end
end

local function spawn<T...>(f: (T...) -> (), ...: T...)
	local thread
	if #freeThreads > 0 then
		thread = freeThreads[#freeThreads]
		freeThreads[#freeThreads] = nil
	else
		thread = coroutine.create(yielder)
		coroutine.resume(thread)
	end

	task.spawn(thread, f, thread, ...)
end

local function spawnCallbacks<Args...>(callbacks: { (Args...) -> () }, ...: Args...)
	for _, callback in callbacks do
		spawn(callback, ...)
	end
end

local function createEvent<Args...>(): Event<Args...>
	local callbacks: { Listener<Args...> } = {}

	return {
		on = function(listener: Listener<Args...>)
			table.insert(callbacks, listener)
			return function()
				local index = table.find(callbacks, listener)
				if index then
					table.remove(callbacks, index)
				end
			end
		end,
		fire = function(...: Args...)
			spawnCallbacks(callbacks, ...)
		end,
	}
end

local untrack = vide.untrack

local function getItemIndex(item: BackpackItem): number?
	local items = untrack(states.items)
	for i, v in items do
		if v == item then
			return i
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function findLowestEmptyHotbarSlot(): number?
	local slots = untrack(states.slots)
	local items = untrack(states.items)
	for i = 1, slots do
		if not items[i] then
			return i
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function findLowestEmptyInventorySlot(): number
	local slots = untrack(states.slots)
	local items = untrack(states.items)
	local initialCount = slots + 1
	local maxItems = math.max(table.maxn(items), initialCount)
	for i = initialCount, maxItems do
		if not items[i] then
			return i
		end
	end
	return maxItems + 1
end

local function findLowestEmptySlot(): number
	local hotbarSlot = findLowestEmptyHotbarSlot()
	if hotbarSlot then
		return hotbarSlot
	end
	return findLowestEmptyInventorySlot()
end

local function closeInventoryGaps(items: typeof(states.items()))
	local slots = untrack(states.slots)
	local invIndex = slots + 1
	local maxItems = math.max(table.maxn(items), invIndex)
	for i = invIndex, maxItems do
		local item = items[i]
		if item then
			if i > invIndex then
				items[i], items[invIndex] = nil, item
			end
			invIndex += 1
		end
	end
end

local function swap(indexA: number, indexB: number)
	if (not indexA or not indexB) or indexA == indexB then
		return false
	end
	local slots = untrack(states.slots)
	local newItems = untrack(states.items)

	newItems[indexA], newItems[indexB] = newItems[indexB], newItems[indexA]

	if indexA > slots or indexB > slots then
		closeInventoryGaps(newItems)
	end
	states.items(newItems)
	return true
end

local function moveToHotbar(index: number)
	if not index then
		return false
	end
	local targetIndex = findLowestEmptyHotbarSlot()
	if not targetIndex then
		return false
	end
	swap(index, targetIndex)
	return true
end

local function moveToInventory(index: number)
	local slots = untrack(states.slots)
	if index > slots then
		return false
	end
	local items = untrack(states.items)
	if not items[index] then
		return false
	end
	local targetIndex = findLowestEmptyInventorySlot()
	swap(index, targetIndex)
	return true
end

local function insertToLowestSlot(item: BackpackItem)
	local index = findLowestEmptySlot()
	local currentItems = untrack(states.items)
	currentItems[index] = item
	states.items(currentItems)
	return index
end

local function removeSlot(index: number)
	local slots = untrack(states.slots)
	local currentItems = untrack(states.items)
	currentItems[index] = nil
	if index > slots then
		closeInventoryGaps(currentItems)
	end
	states.items(currentItems)
end

local function getHotbarItems()
	local items = untrack(states.items)
	local slots = untrack(states.slots)

	local hotbarItems: { BackpackItem } = {}
	for i = 1, slots do
		hotbarItems[i] = items[i]
	end
	return hotbarItems
end

local function setHotbarItems(items: { BackpackItem }, force: boolean?)
	local slots = untrack(states.slots)
	local currentItems = untrack(states.items)

	for i = 1, slots do
		local item = currentItems[i]
		if item and force then
			moveToInventory(i)
		end
		local newItem = items[i]
		if newItem then
			local index = getItemIndex(newItem)
			if index then
				swap(index, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

return {

	removeSlot = removeSlot,

	setHotbarItems = setHotbarItems,
}

type function NonNilableProps(props: type): type
	local config = types.newtable()
	for property, value in props:properties() do
		local read = value.read :: type
		local result = read
		for _, component in read:components() do
			if not component:is("nil") then
				result = component
				break
			end
		end
		config:setproperty(property, result)
	end
	return config
end

type function GetterProps(props: type): type
	local config = types.newtable()
	for property, value in props:properties() do
		config:setproperty(property, types.newfunction({}, { head = { value.read :: type } }))
	end
	return config
end

	local b = useBackpack()
	local itemsIndex = b.itemsIndex

	useEventListener(GuiService.MenuOpened, closeInventory)

	local lastOpened = states.opened()
	effect(function()
		local opened = states.opened()

			lastOpened = opened

			if opened then
				events.inventoryOpened.fire()
			else
				states.gamepadSwapIndex(nil :: any)
				events.inventoryClosed.fire()
			end

			states.rows(config.inventoryRowsPortrait)
		elseif viewportSize == Enum.DisplaySize.Small then
			states.slots(config.hotbarSlotsMini)
			states.rows(config.inventoryRowsMini)
		else
			states.slots(config.hotbarSlotsFull)
			states.rows(config.inventoryRowsFull)

		states.vrEnabled(VRService.VREnabled)
	end)

		local prefInput = states.preferredInput()
		states.keyboardHint(not vr and prefInput == Enum.PreferredInput.KeyboardAndMouse)
		states.gamepadHint(not vr and prefInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad)
	end)

	local lastPressedRight = false

		local pressedSlotLeft = states.inputs.slotLeft()
		local pressedSlotRight = states.inputs.slotRight()

		local becamePressedRight = pressedSlotRight and not lastPressedRight

		lastPressedRight = pressedSlotRight

		if pressedSlotLeft and pressedSlotRight then
			states.equippedItem(nil :: any)
			return
		end

		if not becamePressedLeft and not becamePressedRight then
			return
		end

		local slots = untrack(states.slots)
		local items = untrack(states.items)
		local equipped = untrack(states.equippedItem)

			end
		end

		for index = startIndex, endIndex, moveDirection do
			local item = items[index]
			if item then

			end
		end

	end)

			return
		end
		local inputType = input.UserInputType
		if inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			closeInventory()
		elseif inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			local inputNum = input.KeyCode.Value - Enum.KeyCode.Zero.Value
			inputNum = if inputNum >= 0 and inputNum < 10 then (inputNum == 0 and 10) or inputNum else nil
			if inputNum and inputNum <= states.slots() then

				if item then

		end
	end)

type UsedAs<T> = vide.UsedAs<T>

type function GetterUnwrapArgs(a: type, b: type): type
	local function unwrap(t: type): type
		if t:is("function") then
			local returns = t:returns()
			if returns and returns.head and returns.head[1] then
				return returns.head[1]
			end
		end
		return t
	end

	local t_a = unwrap(a)
	local t_b = unwrap(b)
	return types.newfunction({}, { head = { if t_a == t_b then t_a else types.unionof(t_a, t_b) } })
end

local function ifelse<T0, T1>(fn: UsedAs<unknown>, a: T0, b: T1): GetterUnwrapArgs<T0, T1>
	return function()
		return if read(fn) then read(a) else read(b)
	end :: any
end

local function nott<T>(fn: UsedAs<T>): () -> boolean
	return function()
		return not read(fn)
	end
end

local function all(...)
	local count = select("#", ...)
	local args = { ... }
	return function()
		for i = 1, count do
			if not read(args[i]) then
				return false
			end
		end
		return true
	end
end

local function any(...)
	local count = select("#", ...)
	local args = { ... }
	return function()
		for i = 1, count do
			if read(args[i]) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end
end

local function len<T>(a: UsedAs<{ T }>)
	return function(): number
		return #read(a) :: any
	end
end

local function eq<T>(a: UsedAs<T>, b: UsedAs<T>)
	return function()
		return read(a) == read(b)
	end
end

local function neq<T>(a: UsedAs<T>, b: UsedAs<T>)
	return function()
		return read(a) ~= read(b)
	end
end

local function gt(a: UsedAs<number>, b: UsedAs<number>)
	return function()
		return read(a) > read(b) :: any
	end
end

local function lt(a: UsedAs<number>, b: UsedAs<number>)
	return function()
		return read(a) < read(b) :: any
	end
end

local function gte(a: UsedAs<number>, b: UsedAs<number>)
	return function()
		return read(a) >= read(b) :: any
	end
end

local function lte(a: UsedAs<number>, b: UsedAs<number>)
	return function()
		return read(a) <= read(b) :: any
	end
end

return {
	ifelse = ifelse,
	nott = nott,
	all = all,
	any = any,
	len = len,
	eq = eq,
	neq = neq,
	gt = gt,
	lt = lt,
	gte = gte,
	lte = lte,
}

local function hotbar(): Frame
	local items = derive(function()
		local slots = states.slots()
		local items = states.items()

		local newItems = table.create(slots)
		for i = 1, slots do
			local item = items[i]
			newItems[i] = { item = item }
		end
		return newItems :: { { item: BackpackItem? } }
	end)

	return create("Frame")({
		Name = "Hotbar",
		Active = states.opened,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		Size = px.offset(0, config.slotSize + HOTBAR_PADDING * 2),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = 1,

		action(states.hotbarRef :: any),

		changed("AbsoluteSize", function(size: Vector2)
			states.width(size.X)
		end),

		create("UIListLayout")({
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
			Padding = px.udim(0, HOTBAR_PADDING),
		}),

		create("UIPadding")({
			PaddingLeft = px.udim(0, HOTBAR_PADDING),
			PaddingRight = px.udim(0, HOTBAR_PADDING),
			PaddingTop = px.udim(0, HOTBAR_PADDING),
			PaddingBottom = px.udim(0, HOTBAR_PADDING),
		}),

		indexes(items, function(entry, order)
			local item = derive(function()
				return entry().item :: BackpackItem?
			end)
			return show(cond.any(states.opened, item), function()
				return slot({
					item = item,
					order = order,
					inHotbar = true,
				})
			end)
		end),
	})
end

return hotbar

		local currentItem = item()

local function useBackpack()
	local itemsIndex = derive(function()
		local items = states.items()
		local map = {}
		for i, item in items do
			map[item] = i
		end
		return map
	end)

	local backpack: Backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") :: any
	local character = useCharacter()

	local function onItemAdded(item: BackpackItem)
		local char = untrack(character)
		if item.Parent == char and untrack(states.equippedItem) ~= item then
			states.equippedItem(item)
		end

		if untrack(itemsIndex)[item] then
			return
		end
		slotManager.insertToLowestSlot(item)
		events.backpackItemAdded.fire(item)
	end

	local function onItemRemoved(item: BackpackItem)
		local parent = item.Parent
		local char = untrack(character)
		if parent ~= char and untrack(states.equippedItem) == item then
			states.equippedItem(nil :: any)
		end

		if parent == backpack or parent == char then
			return
		end
		local index = untrack(itemsIndex)[item]
		if not index then
			return
		end
		slotManager.removeSlot(index)
		events.backpackItemRemoved.fire(item)

		if table.maxn(untrack(states.items)) == 0 then
			events.backpackEmpty.fire()
		end
	end

	local function onChildAdded(child: Instance)
		if child:IsA("BackpackItem") then
			onItemAdded(child)
		end
	end

	local function onChildRemoved(child: Instance)
		if child:IsA("BackpackItem") then
			onItemRemoved(child)
		end
	end

	local function observeItems(parent: Instance)
		for _, child in parent:GetChildren() do
			onChildAdded(child)
		end
		useEventListener(parent.ChildAdded, onChildAdded)
		useEventListener(parent.ChildRemoved, onChildRemoved)
	end

	effect(function()
		local char = character()
		if not char then
			return
		end

		-- update backpack reference
		backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") :: any

		observeItems(char)
		observeItems(backpack)

		states.isBackpackLoaded(true)
		events.backpackLoaded.fire(untrack(states.items))

		cleanup(function()
			states.equippedItem(nil :: any)
			states.items({})
			states.isBackpackLoaded(false)
		end)
	end)

	effect(function()
		local equipped = states.equippedItem()
		local char = untrack(character)
		local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid then
			return
		end
		if equipped then
			if equipped.Parent == char then
				return
			end

			if equipped:IsA("HopperBin") then -- NOTE: HopperBin
				warn(`[Sling] Cannot select '{equipped.Name}' hopper. HopperBin is deprecated and not supported.`)
				task.defer(function()
					states.equippedItem(nil :: any)
				end)
			else
				if equipHandler.callback then
					equipHandler.callback(equipped :: Tool)
				else
					humanoid:EquipTool(equipped :: Tool)
				end
			end
		else
			if equipHandler.callback then
				equipHandler.callback(nil)
			else
				humanoid:UnequipTools()
			end
		end
	end)

	local lastEquipped: BackpackItem? = nil
	effect(function()
		local equipped = states.equippedItem()
		if equipped ~= lastEquipped then
			if lastEquipped then
				events.backpackItemUnequipped.fire(lastEquipped)
			end
			if equipped then
				events.backpackItemEquipped.fire(equipped)
			end
			lastEquipped = equipped
		end
	end)

	return {
		itemsIndex = itemsIndex,
	}
end

return useBackpack

type Props = {

local function useCategories(props: Props)
	effect(function()
		local categories = states.categories()
		states.selectedCategory(if #categories > 0 then categories[1].category else "")
	end)

	local allCategories = derive(function()
		local categories = states.categories()
		local width = states.width()
		local maxCategoryWidth = px.scale(props.maxCategoryWidth)()

		local barCategories = {}
		local dropdownCategories = {}
		for i, category in categories do
			local sizeX = (1 / i) * width
			if sizeX > maxCategoryWidth then
				table.insert(barCategories, category)
			else
				table.insert(dropdownCategories, category)
			end
		end
		return { barCategories = barCategories, dropdownCategories = dropdownCategories }
	end)
	local barCategories = derive(function()
		return allCategories().barCategories
	end)
	local dropdownCategories = derive(function()
		return allCategories().dropdownCategories
	end)
	local showDropdown = cond.gt(cond.len(dropdownCategories), 0)
	local categoryWidth = derive(function()
		local barLen = #barCategories()
		return (1 / barLen) * px.raw(states.width) - (if showDropdown() then props.dropdownButtonWidth / barLen else 0)
	end)

	return {
		barCategories = barCategories,
		dropdownCategories = dropdownCategories,
		showDropdown = showDropdown,
		categoryWidth = categoryWidth,
	}
end

return useCategories

local states = require("../../core/states")
local vide = require("../../../vide")

local source = vide.source
local derive = vide.derive

local function useInventory()
	local inventoryItems = derive(function()
		local slots = states.slots()
		local items = states.items()
		local initialCount = slots + 1
		local maxIndex = math.max(table.maxn(items), initialCount)

		local newInventory = {}
		local count = 0
		for i = initialCount, maxIndex do
			local item = items[i]
			if item then
				count += 1
				newInventory[count] = item
			end
		end
		return newInventory
	end)

	local selectedCategoryIndex = derive(function()
		local selectedCategory = states.selectedCategory()
		local categories = states.categories()
		for i, category in categories do
			if category.category == selectedCategory then
				return i
			end
		end
		return 0
	end)

	local searchText = source("")

	local searchTokens = derive(function()
		local text = searchText():lower()
		local tokens = {}
		for token in text:gmatch("%S+") do
			table.insert(tokens, token)
		end
		return tokens
	end)

	local function searchMatches(item: BackpackItem)
		local tokens = searchTokens()
		if #tokens == 0 then
			return true
		end

		local name = item.Name:lower()
		local tooltipText = ""
		if item:IsA("Tool") then
			tooltipText = (item :: Tool).ToolTip:lower()
		end

		for _, token in tokens do
			if name:find(token, 1, true) or tooltipText:find(token, 1, true) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function isVisible(item: BackpackItem)
		local categoryIndex = selectedCategoryIndex()
		local selectedCategory = states.categories()[categoryIndex]

		if selectedCategory and not selectedCategory.predicate(item) then
			return false
		end
		if not searchMatches(item) then
			return false
		end

		return true
	end

	return {
		searchText = searchText,
		items = inventoryItems,
		isVisible = isVisible,
	}
end

return useInventory

local function checkBounds(x: number, y: number, target: GuiObject): boolean
	local absPos = target.AbsolutePosition
	local absSize = target.AbsoluteSize
	return x >= absPos.X and x <= absPos.X + absSize.X and y >= absPos.Y and y <= absPos.Y + absSize.Y
end

local function getClosestFrame(pos: Vector2, parent: Instance, maxDistance: number?): (GuiObject?, number?)
	local closestFrame: GuiObject? = nil
	local minDistance: number = maxDistance or math.huge

	for _, frame in parent:GetChildren() do
		if not frame:IsA("GuiObject") then
			continue
		end

		local center = frame.AbsolutePosition + frame.AbsoluteSize / 2
		local distance = (pos - center).Magnitude

		if distance < minDistance then
			minDistance = distance
			closestFrame = frame
		end
	end

	if closestFrame then
		return closestFrame, minDistance
	else
		return nil, nil
	end
end

local function useSlot(props: {

	local slotFrameRef = source((nil :: any) :: Frame)

	if props.order >= 1 and props.order < 10 then

	elseif props.order == 10 then

	end

		local currentItem = item()
		if not currentItem then
			itemName("")
			itemImage("")
			tooltipText("")

		end

		itemName(currentItem.Name)
		useEventListener(currentItem:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"), function()
			itemName(currentItem.Name)
		end)
		itemImage(currentItem.TextureId)
		useEventListener(currentItem:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextureId"), function()
			itemImage(currentItem.TextureId)
		end)
		if currentItem:IsA("Tool") then
			tooltipText(currentItem.ToolTip)
			useEventListener(currentItem:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ToolTip"), function()
				tooltipText(currentItem.ToolTip)
			end)
		end
	end)

	local getIndex = derive(function()
		local currentItem = item()
		return currentItem ~= nil and slotManager.getItemIndex(currentItem)
			or (if props.inHotbar then props.order else states.slots() + props.order)
	end)

	local function saveHotbar()
		events.hotbarChanged.fire(slotManager.getHotbarItems())
	end

	local function swap(targetIndex: number, force: boolean?)
		local index = untrack(getIndex)
		local items = untrack(states.items)
		local slots = untrack(states.slots)
		if items[index] or force then
			local moved = slotManager.swap(index, targetIndex)
			if moved and (index <= slots or targetIndex <= slots) then
				saveHotbar()
			end
		end
	end

	local function moveToInventory()
		local moved = slotManager.moveToInventory(untrack(getIndex))
		if moved then
			saveHotbar()
		end
	end

	local function moveToHotbar()
		local moved = slotManager.moveToHotbar(untrack(getIndex))
		if moved then
			saveHotbar()
		end
	end

	local lastClickTime = 0
	local doubleClickTime = 0.5

	local function onClick()
		local index = getIndex()

		local isGamepadInput = states.preferredInput() == Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad
		if states.opened() and isGamepadInput and not states.vrEnabled() then
			local activeSwapIndex = states.gamepadSwapIndex()
			if activeSwapIndex then
				states.gamepadSwapIndex(nil :: any)
				if activeSwapIndex ~= index then
					swap(activeSwapIndex, true)
				end
				return
			else
				states.gamepadSwapIndex(index)
				return
			end
		end

		local currentItem = item()
		if not currentItem then
			return
		end

		local currentEquipped = states.equippedItem()
		states.equippedItem(if currentItem == currentEquipped then nil :: any else currentItem)

		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastClickTime < doubleClickTime and not props.inHotbar then
			lastClickTime = 0
			moveToHotbar()
		else
			lastClickTime = now
		end
	end

	local function onDragBegin()
		isDragging(true)

		local slot = slotRef()
		local app = states.appRef()
		if slot and app and not props.inHotbar then
			local newPosition = UDim2.new(
				0,
				slot.AbsolutePosition.X - app.AbsolutePosition.X,
				0,
				slot.AbsolutePosition.Y - app.AbsolutePosition.Y
			)
			slot.Parent = app
			slot.Position = newPosition
		end
	end

	local function onDragStopped(x: number, y: number)
		isDragging(false)

		local slot = slotRef()
		local slotFrame = slotFrameRef()
		if not (slot and slotFrame) then
			return
		end

		if not props.inHotbar then
			slot.Parent = slotFrame
		end
		slot.Position = UDim2.new()

		local hotbar = states.hotbarRef()
		local insideHotbar = hotbar and checkBounds(x, y, hotbar)

		if insideHotbar then
			local closest = getClosestFrame(Vector2.new(x, y), hotbar, config.slotSize / 2)
			if closest and closest ~= slotFrame then
				swap(closest.LayoutOrder)
			end
		elseif props.inHotbar then
			moveToInventory()
		end
	end

	local function useDrag()
		return {
			Draggable = cond.all(states.opened, item),
			DragBegin = onDragBegin,
			DragStopped = onDragStopped,
		}
	end

	effect(function()
		local pressedRemoveFromHotbar = states.inputs.removeFromHotbar()
		if not pressedRemoveFromHotbar or not props.inHotbar then
			return
		end

		local slotBtn = untrack(slotRef)
		if slotBtn and GuiService.SelectedObject == slotBtn then
			moveToInventory()
		end
	end)

	return {
		itemName = itemName,
		itemImage = itemImage,
		tooltipText = tooltipText,
		slotRef = slotRef,
		slotFrameRef = slotFrameRef,
		slotNumber = slotNumber,
		zindex = zindex,
		isDragging = isDragging,
		useDrag = useDrag,
		onClick = onClick,
		getIndex = getIndex,
	}
end

return useSlot
